result.topic_en: Thermodynamic inequalities involving heat quantities U, V, the integrating factor 1/(a+t) and integrals of dQ/(a+t) (Carnot–Clausius type argument), with faint pencil notes on a first-order equation for a wave front and numerical logarithmic calculations of gas constants (a=273, R, K, k=1.41).
